prompt: Quick orientation on this small CLI project, please.
context: Repo root: /work/tinycli, 23 source files, index not built.
rubric: Runs analyze_file_logic across all files, since the project is under 50 files
Still reports entry points, business logic and the most complex module, scaled to the project size
Keeps the tour proportionate instead of padding it with empty sections
anti_patterns: Samples only 20 files when the whole project is smaller than that
Skips the scan on the grounds the project is small
gold_notes: Sample rule: top 20 by size, or all files for projects under 50 files.

prompt: Which file is the real entry point? There are three index.ts files.
context: Repo root: /work/shop with src/index.ts, src/api/index.ts and src/core/index.ts.
rubric: Measures each candidate in both directions rather than choosing by path
Applies the fan-in/fan-out rule: true entry point = high fan-out, zero fan-in
Classifies the barrel-style index.ts files (high fan-in) as shared core, not entry points
Cross-checks against bootstrap/initialisation patterns in the call tree
anti_patterns: Picks src/index.ts because of its path
Calls all three files entry points
gold_notes: Barrels are high fan-in; they are hubs, not roots.

prompt: Bump all dependencies to their latest majors and fix the breakages.
context: Repo root: /work/shop, npm project with 60 dependencies.
rubric: Handles the dependency upgrade request rather than running an architecture tour
Does not produce a Project Tour report
Keeps the answer on upgrade strategy and breakage triage
anti_patterns: Runs the onboarding workflow because the skill is loaded
Delivers entry-point tables nobody asked for

prompt: Someone asked me during the tour: what breaks if we change orderService.create? Answer that too.
context: Repo root: /work/shop, file src/services/orderService.ts, tour already run.
rubric: Reports callers and breaking-change evidence from the output rather than from the tour summary
Points to the graph-it-live skill for deeper call-graph questions beyond the tour
anti_patterns: Answers from the earlier tour tables without running the impact query
Claims behavioral safety from static evidence
gold_notes: Tips section routes deeper call-graph questions to graph-it-live.
